overview: The ICFAI University, Dehradun (IU Dehradun) is a private university in Selaqui, Dehradun, Uttarakhand, established in 2003 under the ICFAI University Act (Act No. 16 of 2003), sponsored by the Institute of Chartered Financial Analysts of India (ICFAI), a non-profit educational society founded in 1984.
student_centric_learning: IU Dehradun follows a student-centred educational model built around hands-on learning, technology-aided pedagogy and a holistic approach that combines domain knowledge, professional skills and life skills.
institution_profile: IU Dehradun is organised into five constituent schools spanning management, technology, law, education and pharmaceutical sciences.
The university is recognised by the UGC under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956.

IU Dehradun's programs are additionally approved by bodies such as the Bar Council of India (BCI), the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE), and the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), depending on the discipline. As a State Act university, IU Dehradun does not require AICTE approval.
The campus is spread over roughly 25 acres at Selaqui, Dehradun, and is fully Wi-Fi enabled.
vision: To build domain knowledge, professional skills and a positive attitude in students through continuous, proactive effort, while fostering a strong culture of research and higher learning among faculty.
mission: To deliver world-class, innovative, career-oriented undergraduate and postgraduate programs through inclusive, technology-aided teaching, equipping students with professional and life skills along with social sensitivity and a strong sense of ethics.
campus: IU Dehradun's campus is at Rajawala Road, Selaqui, Dehradun - 248197, Uttarakhand, India.
campus_metrics: Established in 2003 (22+ years of campus education)
research_and_case_studies: The university's Research and Development Cell (RDC) channels research projects and consultancy work across its schools.
Faculty and research output across the ICFAI network is cited at 15000+ books published, 7000+ case studies and 27+ magazines and journals.
leadership_highlights: Uday Desai is Chancellor of IU Dehradun.
Prof. (Dr.) Ram Karan Singh is Vice-Chancellor of IU Dehradun.
